prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production reference sheet for the Toktogi 2D game. Match the already displayed C011 springtail reference in rounded low-poly cartoon forms, clean dark blue-gray edge definition, restrained surface texture, readable four-tone shading, matte natural green/brown palette (the plant must retain its natural color, not springtail white). Off-white background, uniform neutral light, orthographic multi-view panels: top, front, left, right, back, underside/detail, consistently same object, no perspective distortion, no scenery, no shadow crossing panels, no text on object. Labels outside object in English with asset ID. Broad simple forms suitable for editable low-poly Blender geometry. Do not add a springtail character. This is a reference sheet, not a runtime sprite. Subject: B03 Wolffia arrhiza, a single tiny smooth rootless oval green floating body, selected 1.0 by 0.7 mm, plump ellipsoidal volume with slightly flattened top. ABSOLUTELY NO roots, hairs, stems, conventional leaves or veins in any view. A simple green grain.
style_input_delivery: Reference displayed in conversation; new-image call omitted explicit image-path arguments.
correction: 생성 시트의 top/underside에도 비스듬한 음영이 있다. 실제 모델은 단일 무근 타원체이며 정투영 출력이 방향의 기준이다.
